questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some peas are dogs.

No dog is a cub.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some peas are cubs.

(II) Some dogs are peas.
questions.solution:
Given Statements:

Some peas are dogs.

No dog is a cub.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2f137d70e58967c417c3f38b4d370c9d18a31ddc3b3b88975436a85e4a89cf1f.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some peas are cubs - **Does not follow** (No definite relationship is given between peas and cubs. They may or may not overlap).

II. Some dogs are peas - **Follows** (Since some peas are dogs, it definitely implies that some dogs are peas).

So, only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding to/subtracting from/multiplying with 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

(6, 3, 19)

(4, 3, 13)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: First Number × Second Number + 1 = Third Number**

**For, (6, 3, 19)**

⇒ (6 × 3) + 1 = 18 + 1 = 19

**For, (4, 3, 13)**

⇒ (4 × 3) + 1 = 12 + 1 = 13

Now, checking the options:

**Option 1) (3, 7, 22)**

⇒ (3 × 7) + 1 = 21 + 1 = 22 

Option 2) (5, 4, 16)

⇒ (5 × 4) + 1 = 20 + 1 = 21 (not 16)

Option 3) (8, 3, 26)

⇒ (8 × 3) + 1 = 24 + 1 = 25 (not 26)

Option 4) (5, 8, 40)

⇒ (5 × 8) + 1 = 40 + 1 = 41 (not 40)

Hence, the correct answer is** Option 1.**

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All trees are boats.

No pens are boats.

All combs are trees.

**Conclusions:**

(I) All combs are boats.

(II) No pens are combs.
questions.solution:
Given Statements:

All trees are boats.

No pens are boats.

All combs are trees.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1116060cae8f715f6ece3ab6956f44d1d57be29d5b5c01274c2898f62c225fbf.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All combs are boats - Follows (Since all combs are trees and all trees are boats, all combs must be boats).

II. No pens are combs - Follows (No pens are boats, and all combs are inside boats. Therefore, pens cannot be combs).

So, both conclusion I and conclusion II follow.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 1.**
